original_test_intent: Inject one uncorrectable ECC parity event into the intended IOHUB structure, verify the approved immediate reset and a fresh source-correlated post-boot MCA/BERT/CPER record, then prove platform and IOHUB recovery with all RAS settings restored.
original_method: Map socket/die/NBIO to IOHUB instance and decode group/structure; prove errortype 1 ECC-UCE semantics; document raw threshold FF5/FFE behavior; capture durable baseline and OOB console; inject once; timestamp dispatch, reset, firmware and boot; decode fresh MCA/BERT/CPER source/severity; verify stable OS and IO paths; restore threshold, Platform First, NBIO, FCH and HDT state.
manual_activity: The FAE approves IOHUB target, UCE semantics and threshold policy, performs one injection under OOB capture, owns reset/boot diagnosis and restores raw RAS state.
required_inputs: Socket/die/NBIO-to-IOHUB instance map and vendor meaning of groupid 7/structid 1
Tool/spec version/hash/license and proof errortype 1 selects IOHUB ECC UCE with immediate reset
MCA threshold register encoding and raw FF5 before/FFE target/restore values plus reset interaction
Expected MCA bank/status/source/severity and fresh BERT/CPER PCIe or processor-section fields
Linux and Windows-specific durable evidence path, reset/firmware/boot/OS deadlines and recovery criteria
Supported OS/kernel, aborts, OOB recovery, RDIMM relevance and full restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated backed-up SUT with independent BMC/serial console and known-good boot/reimage path
Capture raw threshold/NBIO/FCH state and persistent-log baseline before any change
Inject once on one mapped IOHUB and do not depend on volatile OS logs
Abort on wrong source/severity, absent reset, boot loop, stale/missing durable record, IO loss or persistent error
No automatic retry/reset; preserve evidence and restore/diff threshold, Platform First, NBIO, FCH and HDT state
agent_execution_scope: Validate topology, group/struct/flag semantics, threshold plan, durable oracle and boot recovery
Collect read-only raw registers, OOB console, MCA/BERT/CPER, BMC/UEFI, reset/boot and post-health evidence
Do not choose tuple/threshold/outcome, change BIOS/HDT, inject/reset/retry/recover or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve IOHUB target, UCE flag and threshold policy
Restore raw state and issue verdict

command_applicability.command_recommendation: After mapping, flag and threshold approval, inject once under OOB capture and correlate exact durable IOHUB UCE source/severity through reset, boot and restored IO health.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run one mapped IOHUB ECC-UCE injection with raw threshold capture and durable OOB/BERT correlation, then prove complete boot and I/O recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds tuple decoding, flag authority, raw threshold rollback, durable source correlation, deadlines and OS-specific evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Tool PASS and post-boot generic text cannot prove the selected IOHUB generated the reset or the record is fresh.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong target or threshold can trigger unexpected SyncFlood, boot loop, lost I/O devices or persistent NBIO fault state.

project_override_considerations: If platform policy handles this UCE without immediate reset, do not force a reset to match prose; retain the disposition conflict for owner resolution. Windows requires its own injector/evidence path rather than the Linux sudo command.
expected_evidence: Tool/spec UCE mapping and raw threshold/RAS pre-state
One injection transcript plus OOB reset/firmware/boot timeline
Fresh decoded MCA/BERT/CPER source/severity correlated to target
Recovered OS and IOHUB-dependent devices/services with no persistent error
Restored raw configuration and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The IOHUB tuple and group/structure are unmapped, errortype 1 UCE/reset semantics lack authority and threshold FF5-to-FFE behavior/restoration is undefined. The source relies on post-boot dmesg without fresh BERT/CPER fields, has no Windows method or reset deadlines, and leaves RDIMM relevance unclear.

blocked_analysis.analysis: IOHUB ECC-UCE reset intent is clear. Engineering can provide topology, flag and durable oracle, so static review completes while execution remains gated.

review_improvement: Adds durable, source-correlated evidence across the immediate reset and makes threshold encoding, boot deadlines and raw-state restoration explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: An immediate reset removes volatile error context, so the result needs firmware-reserved or OOB evidence tied to the selected IOHUB source. A retained BERT record can predate the injection unless baseline identity and freshness are established. The threshold change may alter when escalation occurs; without decoding FF5/FFE, the test could validate threshold behavior rather than a single UCE.
